{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy.Char8 as LBS
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Network.HTTP.Client
import Network.HTTP.Client.TLS
import Network.HTTP.Types.Status (statusCode)
import Data.Aeson
import Data.Aeson.Types (parseMaybe)
import Control.Monad (forever, when, unless)
import Control.Concurrent (threadDelay)
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import qualified Data.HashMap.Strict as HM
import Data.IORef
import Text.Read (readMaybe)
import Network.Socket (getAddrInfo, addrAddress, addrFamily, defaultHints)
import qualified Network.Socket as NS

-- | Configuration for the message queue consumer
data ConsumerConfig = ConsumerConfig
  { cfgQueueEndpoint   :: String
  , cfgCallbackBase    :: String
  , cfgMaxRetries      :: Int
  , cfgAllowedSchemes  :: [Text]
  , cfgAllowedDomains  :: [Text]
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Message from the queue
data QueueMessage = QueueMessage
  { msgId       :: Text
  , msgType     :: Text
  , msgPayload  :: Object
  } deriving (Show)

instance FromJSON QueueMessage where
  parseJSON = withObject "QueueMessage" $ \v -> QueueMessage
    <$> v .: "id"
    <*> v .: "type"
    <*> v .: "payload"

-- | Resolve a webhook target from the message payload
-- Only allows pre-registered service names from an allowlist
resolveWebhookTarget :: ConsumerConfig -> Manager -> QueueMessage -> IO (Maybe String)
resolveWebhookTarget cfg mgr msg = do
  case HM.lookup "callback_ref" (msgPayload msg) of
    Just (String ref) -> resolveFromRegistry cfg mgr ref
    Just (Object nested) -> do
      let mService = parseMaybe (.: "service") nested :: Maybe Text
          mPath    = parseMaybe (.: "path") nested :: Maybe Text
      case (mService, mPath) of
        (Just svc, Just path) -> do
          baseUrl <- resolveServiceName cfg mgr svc
          case baseUrl of
            Just base -> do
              let fullUrl = base <> T.unpack (sanitizePath path)
              validated <- validateResolvedUrl cfg fullUrl
              if validated then return $ Just fullUrl
              else return Nothing
            Nothing   -> return Nothing
        _ -> return Nothing
    _ -> return Nothing

-- | Sanitize path component - only allow safe characters
sanitizePath :: Text -> Text
sanitizePath p =
  let cleaned = T.filter (\c -> c `elem` (['a'..'z'] ++ ['A'..'Z'] ++ ['0'..'9'] ++ "/-_.")) p
      -- Prevent path traversal
      noTraversal = T.replace ".." "" cleaned
  in if T.isPrefixOf "/" noTraversal then noTraversal else T.cons '/' noTraversal

-- | Resolve service name through internal Kubernetes service registry
-- Only allows services from the configured allowlist
resolveServiceName :: ConsumerConfig -> Manager -> Text -> IO (Maybe String)
resolveServiceName cfg mgr serviceName = do
  -- Strict allowlist check on service name
  if serviceName `elem` cfgAllowedDomains cfg
    then do
      let registryUrl = cfgCallbackBase cfg <> "/api/v1/services/" <> T.unpack serviceName
      req <- parseRequest registryUrl
      resp <- httpLbs req mgr
      if statusCode (responseStatus resp) == 200
        then do
          let body = responseBody resp
          case decode body of
            Just (Object o) -> case HM.lookup "endpoint" o of
              Just (String ep) -> do
                valid <- validateResolvedUrl cfg (T.unpack ep)
                if valid then return $ Just (T.unpack ep)
                else return Nothing
              _ -> return Nothing
            _ -> return Nothing
        else return Nothing
    else return Nothing

-- | Resolve callback_ref - only service names allowed, no direct URLs
resolveFromRegistry :: ConsumerConfig -> Manager -> Text -> IO (Maybe String)
resolveFromRegistry cfg mgr ref = do
  -- Never allow direct URLs from message payload
  if isDirectUrl ref
    then return Nothing
    else resolveServiceName cfg mgr ref

-- | Check if a reference is a direct URL
isDirectUrl :: Text -> Bool
isDirectUrl t = T.isPrefixOf "http://" t || T.isPrefixOf "https://" t ||
                T.isInfixOf "://" t || T.isPrefixOf "//" t

-- | Validate resolved URL against security policy
-- Performs DNS resolution and checks the actual IP address
validateResolvedUrl :: ConsumerConfig -> String -> IO Bool
validateResolvedUrl cfg url = do
  case parseRequest url of
    Just req -> do
      let host = T.pack $ BS.unpack $ host req
      resolved <- resolveAndCheckIP host
      return resolved
    Nothing -> return False
  where
    resolveAndCheckIP :: Text -> IO Bool
    resolveAndCheckIP hostText = do
      let hostStr = T.unpack hostText
      addrs <- getAddrInfo (Just defaultHints) (Just hostStr) Nothing
      case addrs of
        [] -> return False
        -- Reject if ANY resolved address is private/internal, not just the first
        _  -> return $ not (any (isPrivateAddr . addrAddress) addrs)

-- | Check if a socket address is in private/internal ranges
isPrivateAddr :: NS.SockAddr -> Bool
isPrivateAddr (NS.SockAddrInet _ hostAddr) =
  let (a, b, c, d) = NS.hostAddressToTuple hostAddr
  in a == 10 ||
     (a == 172 && b >= 16 && b <= 31) ||
     (a == 192 && b == 168) ||
     a == 127 ||
     a == 169 && b == 254 ||
     a == 0
isPrivateAddr (NS.SockAddrInet6 _ _ hostAddr _) =
  let (a, _, _, _, _, _, _, _) = NS.hostAddress6ToTuple hostAddr
  in a == 0 || a == 0xfe80 || a == 0xfd00 || a == 1
isPrivateAddr _ = True  -- deny unknown address types

-- | Deliver webhook notification to resolved target
deliverWebhook :: Manager -> String -> QueueMessage -> IO Bool
deliverWebhook mgr targetUrl msg = do
  let body = encode $ object
        [ "message_id" .= msgId msg
        , "type"       .= msgType msg
        , "payload"    .= msgPayload msg
        ]
  initReq <- parseRequest targetUrl
  let req = initReq
        { method = "POST"
        , requestBody = RequestBodyLBS body
        , requestHeaders = [("Content-Type", "application/json")]
        , redirectCount = 0  -- Do not follow redirects
        }
  resp <- httpLbs req mgr
  return $ statusCode (responseStatus resp) < 400

-- | Process a single message from the queue
processMessage :: ConsumerConfig -> Manager -> QueueMessage -> IO ()
processMessage cfg mgr msg = do
  putStrLn $ "Processing message: " <> T.unpack (msgId msg)
  target <- resolveWebhookTarget cfg mgr msg
  case target of
    Just url -> do
      putStrLn $ "Delivering to: " <> url
      success <- deliverWebhook mgr url msg
      unless success $ putStrLn "Delivery failed"
    Nothing -> putStrLn "Could not resolve webhook target"

-- | Poll queue for messages
pollQueue :: ConsumerConfig -> Manager -> IO [QueueMessage]
pollQueue cfg mgr = do
  let url = cfgQueueEndpoint cfg <> "/messages?limit=10"
  req <- parseRequest url
  resp <- httpLbs req mgr
  case decode (responseBody resp) of
    Just msgs -> return msgs
    Nothing   -> return []

-- | Main consumer loop
main :: IO ()
main = do
  queueEp <- fromMaybe "http://queue-svc.default.svc.cluster.local:8080" <$> lookupEnv "QUEUE_ENDPOINT"
  callbackBase <- fromMaybe "http://registry-svc.default.svc.cluster.local:9090" <$> lookupEnv "CALLBACK_BASE"
  let cfg = ConsumerConfig
        { cfgQueueEndpoint  = queueEp
        , cfgCallbackBase   = callbackBase
        , cfgMaxRetries     = 3
        , cfgAllowedSchemes = ["https"]
        , cfgAllowedDomains = ["webhook-alpha", "webhook-beta", "notification-svc"]
        }
  mgr <- newManager tlsManagerSettings
  putStrLn "Starting message queue consumer..."
  forever $ do
    msgs <- pollQueue cfg mgr
    mapM_ (processMessage cfg mgr) msgs
    threadDelay 1000000
